description: Solves the three H_3(q) Markov equations at convention D. y_(1^3) = 0 falls out of the linear system (an independent re-derivation of the two-row cap), the surviving weights are q^2/(q^2+1)^2 and (q^4+1)/(q^2+1)^2, and BOTH are bar-even. So no quantity built from the D-frame weights alone carries a bar-odd part — the bar-ODD eigenphase the C-frame ladder uses cannot be assembled from them.
q0AnchorReason: q-GENERIC: solves and factors over the symbol `q` and never evaluates at any anchor, so there is no pin to record. Deliberately carries no `q0Value` — the audit correctly reads one alongside `independent` as a contradiction, since it would mean something did supply a pin. Contrast the step-1 probe `qbeta_d_frame_eigenphase_bar_parity_probe`, which evaluates the ladder at both anchors and so does carry one.
scope: scope-(a), and NEGATIVE: this narrows where a D-frame ladder derivation may look; it does not supply one. Nothing wired, no c_k value or tier changes, channel stays `disputed`. It does NOT show the decay trace IS the D one — that is the 2026-08-15 owner ruling.

assertions.name: 1_threeRow_vanishes_at_zD
assertions.detail: y_(1^3) = 0 falls out of the Markov linear system at z_D — an independent re-derivation of the two-row cap, not imported from Wenzl

assertions.name: 2_threeRow_survives_at_zC
assertions.detail: y_(1^3) != 0 at z_C — the C-frame trace does not factor through Temperley-Lieb (consistent with decayLadder_zC_threeRow_ne_zero)

assertions.name: 3_two_row_weights_normalise_exactly
assertions.detail: y_(3) + 2 y_(2,1) = 1 exactly at z_D; the two-row weights alone saturate the normalisation

assertions.name: 4_all_D_weights_bar_even
assertions.detail: bar(y) = y for every surviving D-frame weight — no bar-odd part anywhere in the D weight data

result.verdict: Convention D's H_3 Markov trace is two-row with bar-EVEN weights. The C-frame ladder's bar-odd content comes from z_C bar-even against a bar-ODD h; under D that source is gone from the weights. A D-frame phase carrying the C-frame's bar parity must come from the h factor, the Kashiwara f~_1 shift, or the framing — or not exist.

context.step_1: qbeta-d-frame-eigenphase-bar-parity — bar(alpha)+alpha = h^2/2 under D; the forced projection alpha - h^2/4 is necessary but not sufficient
context.corroborates: WenzlWeightVanishing.lean (all n, z_D is Wenzl level r = 2) — reached here independently from the Markov side
